source.title: Emergence of quantum theories from classical probability: historical origins, developments, and open problems

trace.notes: Normalized the input as one zbMATH resolver URL with identifier 8099887. Direct access to the zbMATH page returned a Cloudflare challenge, so the zbMATH REST API was used only as resolver metadata.

Resolver metadata identified the exact work as a 2020 Journal of Stochastic Analysis article by Luigi Accardi and Yun-Gang Lu with DOI 10.31390/josa.1.4.09 and an LSU Digital Commons PDF link. The LSU landing page was metadata-only and the PDF endpoint returned HTTP 403 Forbidden instead of a readable PDF.

Bounded recovery attempted the DOI target, the LSU Digital Commons landing/PDF endpoint, the University of Bari repository handle, and exact-title search results. The LSU and zbMATH endpoints were blocked or challenged, the LSU page itself contained only citation/download metadata, the University of Bari page was Cloudflare-challenged, and exact-title results exposed only metadata/abstract pages or different works. No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML technical source was recovered.

failure_mode=blocked_or_challenged; Input could not be normalized to a readable PDF or HTML full-text source. Extraction was not performed because the available pages were resolver/citation metadata or blocked download endpoints.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-8099887.json and outputs/latest.json.
